title: A Thorn for the Choir
author: J. M. Villalobos
blurb: Ines Ishikawa, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
